about: One row per skill (5 per hero). slot: primary=M1 gun, secondary=M2 (Deadlock ability 1), utility=Shift (ability 2), special=R (a new move from a Deadlock item, melee or ability, on a normal cooldown), equipment=Q (the hero's Deadlock ultimate as a RoR2 equipment: every hero starts holding their own, anyone can find it wherever the Preon Accumulator can drop; design/equipment.json). Numbers are RoR2-scale: damagePct is % of the body's damage stat (RoR2 convention), cooldowns are RoR2 seconds. deadlock* columns hold the source values read from the player's Deadlock scripts/abilities.vdata (ClientVersion 6774) so every conversion is traceable. kind picks the generic EntityState that implements the row. Unused numeric params are 0, unused refs are "none" (filled on purpose, not missing). Balance targets: sustained primary DPS 240-600 %/s (Commando Double Tap ~ 400 %/s incl. downtime); secondaries 2-15 s; utilities 4-12 s; specials 4-30 s; equipment ults 120 s cooldown (60-120 allowed: Goo Ball 100 s since 0.9.0f) and at least 6000 % per enemy (Preon Accumulator scaled from 140 s to 120 s; no upper limit: the ults are pickups any survivor can carry and are left out of balance). buffStacks: stacks of buff a hit adds (Phantom Strike's Fixation, Torment Pulse's Afterburn build-up; Flame Dash: the gun's buff each fire pocket adds every interval), 0 = the usual one. knockback: dashes and punches knock enemies away at this many m/s (0 = none). minDuration: hold skills (the Seismic Impact hover) last at least this long on a tap and at most duration while held; 0 otherwise. vfx: our own Unity-built visual for the skill (an effects row of kind custom), or none. extra: a second RoR2 object the kind spawns (an effects row: the Warbanner ward of Thunderhead), a behaviour flag (pierce: the projectile flies through every enemy in its line; shockwave: the punch also hits every enemy in a cone of length 2x radius and half-angle spreadDeg), or none. expect: what the skill must measurably do, checked in test mode (enemy_damage, enemy_stun, enemy_burn, enemy_debuff:<buff>, self_buff:<buff>, self_heal, self_move, self_cloak). pattern: a fixed pellet pattern instead of random spread (krill: Deadlock's centre pellet and a triangle of three, corners spreadDeg out), or none. cooldownOnEnd: the cooldown starts when the move ends (Dust Devil), not when it starts. debuff: a second buff the move gives (Burrow's pop-out slow on enemies; Tag Team's max-health trophies on the thrower, per kill), or none. bossMult: how much of the move's control a boss (champion) gets: a pull's strength, a disarm's length, 0 = no knock-up on bosses; for Tag Team the max-health stacks a boss kill gives. reach: a second distance (Tag Team's hop range, the punch's reach). splashPct: damage around the main target (Tag Team's landing splash, within radius). meleePct / meleeRate: on a gun row, the punch M1 throws instead of firing while a buff with melee=true is on (Mo while Krill is away: damage per punch, punches per second). meleeKnock: the punch throws each enemy it hits away from the hero at this many m/s (mass-scaled, bosses at a quarter), 0 = none. On cone_wave, minDuration is the wind-up before the wave leaves (the cone is shown on the ground meanwhile). gravity: extra downward pull on a gun projectile (m/s2; gun_goo blobs drop about 1 m at 30 m). falloffStart/falloffEnd/falloffMinPct: a projectile's damage falls linearly from 100% at falloffStart metres travelled to falloffMinPct % at falloffEnd and stays there. ammoCost: the move costs that many rounds of the gun's magazine instead of a cooldown (lob_ammo: Splatter); with fewer left it still fires, its radius scaled by rounds/ammoCost. puddleMult: the radius is multiplied by this when the move lands on a goo puddle (Puddle Punch). launchHeight: allies and the hero standing in the move are thrown this many metres up (a bounce pad), no fall damage on that landing. damageMinPct: the smallest damage of a move that scales with speed (Goo Ball: damageMinPct at a crawl, damagePct at top speed). For lob_ammo, reach / chainCount / interval are the puddle's radius, seconds and tick, and debuff the buff it gives allies inside (Slick). puddleAmmo: rounds a goo puddle of this row holds for its owner: while the owner stands in it, it tops the gun's magazine up from that supply (never above the magazine; a reload under way is called off) until the supply is used up, 0 = none. puddleShrink: seconds the puddle takes to draw in to nothing after its chainCount seconds whole (its reach shrinks with it), 0 = it just ends. Rat King (v0.9.0): pattern ratking = one pellet dead on the aim and one strayed up to spreadDeg (Deadlock's Sovereign's Decree), falloffStart/End/MinPct on its bullets. lob_scrap (Scrap Grenade): radius is the first two blasts' size, splashPct and reach the final blast's damage and size, chainCount the number of blasts, interval the final fuse (s), range its flight, seekRange how far it looks for an enemy to hop toward, buff the slow of the small blasts and debuff of the last, knockback a small shove (bosses x bossMult), extra the grenade's model. rat_ring (Royal Pestments): radius the ring, reach its height above the ground, range how far below him it looks for ground, chainCount the rats drawn, extra the rat model. banner_leap (Rule, Ratannia!): minDuration the wind-up, duration the longest leap, range the farthest landing, speed the leap's forward speed, radius / damagePct the inner blast, reach / splashPct the outer one with stunDuration (bosses x bossMult), only enemies the banner can see; chainCount the seconds the banner stays, extra its model. ult_swarm (Rat Swarm, no time limit: duration 0): buffStacks rats (using it again tops them back up to that), chainCount at most per enemy (x bossMult on bosses), each rat bites until its enemy dies and is then gone, spare rats follow the carrier to the end of the stage, range and seekRange how far from the carrier they hunt, reach how high a rat can leap onto a flyer, interval between one rat's bites, speed the rats' run, extra the rat model. seekRange: how far a move looks for enemies to go after on its own (Scrap Grenade's hops, Rat Swarm's rats), 0 = it doesn't. storm_flight (Seven's Storm Cloud, R): he rises launchHeight metres, then flies for duration with gravity off: Jump climbs and Sprint (or Utility) sinks at speed m/s, moveSpeedMult of his move speed sideways, at most reach metres above where he started; every interval everything within radius takes damagePct and one stack of buff; no gun or skills while it runs (cooldownOnEnd). projectile_orb (Lightning Ball): moveSpeedMult is the ball's speed while an enemy is inside its radius (0.5 = half speed). Billy (v0.11.0): airMult multiplies a move's damage while the hero is in the air (the bat 2x, Bashdown's air target 2x). hangTime: each air hit holds the hero, and the enemy it hits if that enemy is in the air (floating or not; bosses excepted), that many seconds more (creator 2026-10-22: 1 s, to juggle); floatTime: a float's length (Rising Ram) or the most a float can be kept up to and the hero's hang budget per trip in the air (the bat). refillPct: each hit of the move puts that % of the gun's magazine back (Deadlock's Blasted). lockRange: lock-on to the nearest enemy in line of sight within that many metres (the bat only in the air), turning to it; the air bat then dodges onto it (up to reach metres, at the hero's G.O.A.T. dodge speed, moved exactly, in the dodge's clip, sound and trails; the hit lands as he arrives) and hangs there for the hit. 'In the air' is any moment off the floor, the first frames of a jump included. hitRefund: the fraction of the cooldown given back when the move connects (Rising Ram 0.5). pattern octagon: Biquette's spray, the first shot after the trigger is pressed dead centre, then 8 fixed points spreadDeg out in Deadlock's order (carrying on between bursts). bat_combo: burst swings of duration seconds each (damagePct, the last splashPct), radius reach and spreadDeg half-angle in front, the combo starts over after interval seconds without a swing; one press is one swing (duration = Deadlock's full melee clip, and the cooldown the same, creator 2026-10-22), holding the key does not repeat it; the gun waits minDuration after the last swing. bashdown: minDuration the ground hop, damagePct / stunDuration / knockback to the locked target on the ground (bosses bossMult of the stun) plus splashPct to every other enemy within reach; in the air it dives at speed m/s, damagePct x airMult to the target and damagePct to every enemy within radius, all slammed into the floor and stunned duration seconds. rising_ram: duration a steerable wind-up, then a range-metre charge at speed m/s that stops at the first enemy or wall: damagePct to it, every non-boss enemy standing on the ground within radius (flyers and enemies already in the air only take the hit) rises launchHeight metres in minDuration seconds into a floatTime float (stunned), and the hero rises with them; ground only. ult_chains: chains to up to chainCount enemies within radius in sight; interval the throw, then they rise launchHeight metres by minDuration, hang until duration, and are slammed down for damagePct and stunDuration (bosses are slammed where they stand); the carrier is rooted until then. chainPct: Billy's Rising Ram throws chains (Chain Gang's) onto every enemy it launches, breaking at the top; air Bashdown runs chains from the slammed enemy to every other enemy in the air it drags down, breaking as they land (none on the ground version); each chain deals chainPct % of the move's damagePct (creator, 2026-10-22; Rising Ram 6 s, Bashdown 4 s). Wraith (v0.11.0): recoil: on a gun row, how many degrees the hero's chest kicks up with each shot (every machine sees it; the shotguns 9, the other guns 3); aimKick: on a gun row, how hard each shot kicks the owner's own camera up (RoR2's recoil, Commando's Double Tap = 1; 0 = none). On a full_auto row (Wraith's Full Auto) recoil is instead how much stronger both kicks are while it runs (1.2 = 20%). dotTime: seconds a bleed or burn the move puts on lasts. card_trick (Card Trick): one card that homes on the enemy nearest the crosshair within lockRange (or, thrown at nothing, on any enemy within seekRange of its path) at speed m/s for range m; on the throw it draws one of four suits, each its own effect on the hit: bleed (buffStacks stacks of RoR2's Bleed for dotTime s), crit (a certain critical hit, double damage), stun (stunDuration s) or burn (buffStacks stacks of RoR2's Burn for dotTime s); damagePct either way. mind_port (Project Mind): a marker follows the crosshair on the ground up to range metres away (in line of sight); any key (M1, M2, Shift, R, Q, jump) pressed after minDuration teleports her there at once, and after duration s she goes on her own. full_auto (Full Auto): the reload clip plays and the magazine is filled; buff then raises the fire rate (its attackSpeedAdd) and the kick until that magazine is empty (it then reloads at the normal speed and the buff ends). ult_telekinesis (Telekinesis): every enemy within radius rises launchHeight m by minDuration s (stunned), hangs until interval s, then is thrown reach m along the carrier's aim at speed m/s; where it lands it takes damagePct (x airMult if it hit a wall on the way); thrown off a cliff it simply falls. Bosses rise launchHeight x bossMult, are not thrown, and at the throw take damagePct and a stunDuration stun.

rows.name: Twin SMGs
rows.description: Fire Haze's SMGs for <style=cIsDamage>55% damage</style> per bullet. Every hit stacks <style=cIsUtility>Fixation</style> on the target (<style=cIsDamage>critical hits stack 3</style>). 25-round magazine.

rows.name: Sleep Dagger
rows.description: Throw a dagger that <style=cIsUtility>pierces</style> every enemy in a line for <style=cIsDamage>500% damage</style> and puts them to <style=cIsUtility>sleep</style> (stunned) for 4s. Doesn't break Smoke Bomb.

rows.name: Smoke Bomb
rows.description: Vanish into smoke: become <style=cIsUtility>invisible</style> (enemies lose track of you and can't target you) and gain <style=cIsUtility>+50% movement speed</style> for 5s. Firing your guns reveals you.

rows.name: Phantom Strike
rows.description: Blink behind the enemy you aim at (up to 30m away) and cut it with <style=cIsDamage>3 dagger slashes for 250% damage</style> each, hitting <style=cIsDamage>every enemy within 5m</style> of it. Every slash adds <style=cIsUtility>5 Fixation</style>. No target, no cast.

rows.name: Bullet Dance
rows.description: Spin for 5s, firing at <style=cIsDamage>every enemy</style> within 25m at once for <style=cIsDamage>113% damage</style> 12 times a second (about <style=cIsDamage>6800%</style> to each enemy), with a <style=cIsUtility>30% chance to evade</style> attacks.

rows.name: Shotgun
rows.description: Blast 9 pellets for <style=cIsDamage>9x52% damage</style>. 9-shell magazine.

rows.name: Siphon Life
rows.description: For 8s, tether up to <style=cIsUtility>3 enemies within 25m</style> like a Mired Urn, draining them for <style=cIsDamage>450% damage per second</style> each and <style=cIsHealing>healing for all of it</style>.

rows.name: Shoulder Charge
rows.description: Charge forward for up to 3s. Every enemy you run into takes <style=cIsDamage>1600% damage</style>, is <style=cIsUtility>knocked aside</style> out of your path and <style=cIsUtility>stunned</style> for 1s.

rows.name: Haymaker
rows.description: Lock onto the enemy you aim at within 20m (even one in the air) and rush straight at it into a heavy punch for <style=cIsDamage>2400% damage</style>. Its <style=cIsDamage>shockwave</style> hits every enemy in a 6m cone behind it for the same damage and <style=cIsUtility>knocks them flying</style>. No target, no cast.

rows.name: Seismic Impact
rows.description: Leap into the air and hover for up to 3s while you pick a spot within 40m, then <style=cIsUtility>fire (Left Click)</style> to crash down for <style=cIsDamage>6800% damage</style> in an 18m radius, <style=cIsUtility>stunning</style> enemies for 1.6s. You can be hit while you hover.

rows.name: Shock Rifle
rows.description: Fire a 3-round burst for <style=cIsDamage>3x60% damage</style>. Hits build <style=cIsUtility>Static</style>. 29-round magazine.

rows.name: Lightning Ball
rows.description: Hurl a ball of lightning that <style=cIsUtility>flies through enemies</style> and <style=cIsUtility>bounces off walls and floors</style>, shocking everything within 10m for <style=cIsDamage>240% damage per second</style> for 5s. It <style=cIsUtility>slows to half speed</style> while enemies are inside it. Every shock builds <style=cIsUtility>Static</style>.

rows.name: Static Charge
rows.description: Plant a static charge on the enemy (or spot) you aim at. After 1.5s it discharges for <style=cIsDamage>225% damage</style> to everything within 8m and <style=cIsUtility>stuns</style> them for 0.9s.

rows.name: Storm Cloud
rows.description: Rise into the air as a living storm for 10s: the <style=cIsUtility>3 nearest enemies</style> within 15m are <style=cIsDamage>shocked for 100% damage</style> every 0.5s, building <style=cIsUtility>Static</style>. <style=cIsUtility>Jump</style> to fly higher, <style=cIsUtility>Sprint</style> to sink. You can't attack or use skills while it runs; the cooldown starts when you land.

rows.name: Thunderhead
rows.description: Call a storm on the spot where you stand: for 10s, lightning strikes up to 4 enemies inside its 20m radius every 0.4s for <style=cIsDamage>272% damage</style> (<style=cIsDamage>6800%</style> per enemy), and allies inside get a <style=cIsUtility>Warbanner</style> (+30% attack and movement speed).

rows.name: Flame Gun
rows.description: Fire for <style=cIsDamage>75% damage</style> per bullet. Hits build <style=cIsDamage>Afterburn</style>; at full build-up the target <style=cIsDamage>burns</style>. 27-round magazine.

rows.name: Napalm
rows.description: Hold a flask of napalm (a marker shows where it will land), then <style=cIsUtility>Left Click</style> to lob it; it bursts in a 5m splash for <style=cIsDamage>300% damage</style>. Enemies hit are <style=cIsUtility>slowed by 28%</style> for 4s and take <style=cIsDamage>+16% damage</style> from you for 8s. 2 charges.

rows.name: Flame Dash
rows.description: Run at high speed for <style=cIsUtility>5s</style> with <style=cIsUtility>50% slow resistance</style>, <style=cIsUtility>knocking aside</style> enemies you run into. You leave <style=cIsDamage>pockets of fire</style> that burn for 5s; every 0.5s each enemy inside builds <style=cIsDamage>3 Afterburn</style>, and overlapping pockets stack.

rows.name: Torment Pulse
rows.description: For 6s, rings of fire pulse out of you every 0.5s, burning everything within 10m for <style=cIsDamage>50% damage</style> and adding <style=cIsUtility>2 Afterburn</style> build-up.

rows.name: Concussive Combustion
rows.description: Become a bomb: after 3s you explode for <style=cIsDamage>6800% damage</style> to everything within 18m, <style=cIsUtility>stunning</style> enemies for 2s. Each kill <style=cIsHealing>heals you for 10%</style> of your health. You can move while it builds.

rows.name: Yellow Canary
rows.description: Krill fires 4 pellets in a fixed triangle for <style=cIsDamage>4x40% damage</style>. 20-shot magazine. While Krill is away (Tag Team), Mo goes into a <style=cIsDamage>Frenzy</style>: double speed and punches for <style=cIsDamage>600%</style> that knock monsters flying.

rows.name: Sand Blast
rows.description: Wind up, then spray a cone of sand 20m out for <style=cIsDamage>400% damage</style> to everything it passes, throwing monsters back. Hit monsters are <style=cIsUtility>Sanded</style>: they can't attack for 2s (1s for bosses) and are slowed 30%. The cone shows on the ground as he winds up. Works while burrowed.

rows.name: Burrow
rows.description: Dig underground for up to 8s, moving <style=cIsUtility>three times as fast</style> with <style=cIsHealing>+100 armor</style>. Burst out (Shift or Jump, or after 8s) in a spin that hits everything within 8m <style=cIsDamage>3 times for 500%</style>, knocks monsters up and slows them 50%. Press Q underground to burst straight into Dust Devil.

rows.name: Tag Team
rows.description: Throw Krill at the enemy you aim at (40m). For 8s he leaps from enemy to enemy every 0.5s, each landing dealing <style=cIsDamage>400% damage</style>, <style=cIsDamage>150%</style> to everything within 4m, and <style=cIsUtility>stunning</style> for 1s. Mo goes into a Frenzy meanwhile. No target, no throw.

rows.name: Dust Devil
rows.description: Spin into a sand tornado for 5s, <style=cIsUtility>pulling in</style> every enemy within 16m and hitting everything within 8m for <style=cIsDamage>450% four times a second</style>. Keep walking and jumping while it spins. Any survivor holding it spins.

rows.name: Deep Sea Interpreter
rows.description: Fire blobs of goo for <style=cIsDamage>120% damage</style>, 5 a second. Each hit stacks <style=cIsUtility>Gooed</style>. The blobs <style=cIsUtility>drop over distance</style> and lose damage past 20m (40% at 45m). 20-round magazine.

rows.name: Splatter
rows.description: <style=cIsUtility>Right Click</style> to aim (a goo dome shows the splash), <style=cIsUtility>Left Click</style> to lob a ball of goo that flies through enemies and splashes on the floor: <style=cIsDamage>150% damage</style> in 10m and <style=cIsUtility>3 Gooed</style>. It leaves a 6.4m <style=cIsUtility>goo puddle</style> for 3s that then shrinks away over 5s; it adds 1 Gooed a second to enemies standing in it, speeds up allies and <style=cIsUtility>refills your gun while you stand in it</style>. <style=cIsUtility>No cooldown</style>: each throw costs <style=cIsDamage>5 rounds</style>; with fewer left the splash shrinks.

rows.name: The Cube
rows.description: Seal yourself in a goo cube for 3s: <style=cIsUtility>invulnerable</style> and frozen, sliding on with your momentum. Tar tethers latch onto the 4 nearest enemies within 13m, each draining <style=cIsDamage>100% damage per second</style> and <style=cIsHealing>healing you</style> for it. Then the cube bursts for <style=cIsDamage>600% damage</style> in 16m, <style=cIsUtility>maxing Gooed</style>, leaves an 8m <style=cIsUtility>goo puddle</style> like Splatter's, and you move 30% faster for 3s.

rows.name: Puddle Punch
rows.description: Place a giant goo fist anywhere within 40m (<style=cIsUtility>Left Click</style>): it punches up out of the ground for <style=cIsDamage>800% damage</style> in 6m, <style=cIsUtility>knocking enemies up</style> and adding 2 Gooed, and leaves a 6.4m <style=cIsUtility>goo puddle</style> like Splatter's. On a goo puddle it is <style=cIsUtility>twice as wide</style>. You and allies standing on it are <style=cIsUtility>bounced 20m into the air</style>. 2 charges.

rows.name: Goo Ball
rows.description: Become a huge ball of goo for 15s (+100 armor). Steer it, on the ground and in the air; it rolls faster downhill and bounces off walls. Smashing into enemies deals <style=cIsDamage>375-1500% damage</style> by speed, <style=cIsUtility>stuns</style>, launches them and maxes Gooed. Jump high (twice); landing slams for <style=cIsDamage>1125%</style> in 8m. Q again to stop.

rows.name: Sovereign's Decree
rows.description: Belt-fed spreadshot: <style=cIsDamage>2x80% damage</style> per shot, 5 shots a second. One pellet always goes exactly where you aim, the other strays a little. Full damage to 20m, falling to 40% at 50m. 24-round belt; you can watch it shorten.

rows.name: Scrap Grenade
rows.description: <style=cIsUtility>Right Click</style> readies a scrap grenade and shows its arc; <style=cIsUtility>click</style> to throw. It blasts <style=cIsDamage>3 times</style>: two 8m blasts for <style=cIsDamage>300%</style>, <style=cIsUtility>hopping toward the nearest enemy</style> after each, then sits for 0.8s and goes off in a 12m blast for <style=cIsDamage>600%</style>. Blasts <style=cIsUtility>slow by 20%</style> (the last by 40%) for 4s.

rows.name: Royal Pestments
rows.description: Rats pour out from under your cape and run in circles around you for 6s, a <style=cIsUtility>10m ring on the ground</style> that follows you. Every enemy inside (up to 4m off the ground) is bitten for <style=cIsDamage>50% damage</style> four times a second.

rows.name: Rule, Ratannia!
rows.description: Raise the banner of Ratannia and <style=cIsUtility>leap up to 20m</style> toward the crosshair, then slam it into the ground: <style=cIsDamage>1500% damage</style> within 4m of it, and everything within 14m that the banner can see is <style=cIsUtility>stunned for 3s</style> and takes <style=cIsDamage>150%</style>. The banner stays planted for 8s.

rows.name: Rat Swarm
rows.description: 50 rats pour out and stay at your feet until they find an enemy within 40m. Each leaps on and bites for <style=cIsDamage>100% damage</style> once a second until that enemy dies, then is gone. <style=cIsUtility>Up to 5 rats per enemy, 10 on bosses</style>. Spare rats follow you to the end of the stage; using it again tops them back up to 50.

rows.name: Biquette
rows.description: Full-auto machine gun: <style=cIsDamage>50% damage</style> a bullet, 10 a second, 30-round magazine. Deadlock's octagon spray: the first bullet goes dead centre, the rest cycle through 8 points around the crosshair. Full damage to 14m, down to 40% at 32m.

rows.name: Bat
rows.description: Swing the spiked bat in a 3-hit combo: <style=cIsDamage>180%</style>, <style=cIsDamage>180%</style>, then a <style=cIsDamage>360%</style> overhead, hitting everything in a 4m arc in front. Each press is one full swing (0.67s), and the bat is ready again as the swing ends. <style=cIsUtility>In the air</style> every swing deals <style=cIsDamage>double</style>, <style=cIsUtility>dodges onto the nearest enemy within 10m</style> (any direction), and each hit <style=cIsUtility>stalls your fall and the enemy’s for 1s</style> (up to 4s in the air), so you can juggle. Every hit <style=cIsUtility>reloads 35% of Biquette</style>.

rows.name: Bashdown
rows.description: Lock onto the nearest enemy within 5m and bring the bat down. <style=cIsUtility>On the ground</style>: <style=cIsDamage>1000%</style>, knocked back and <style=cIsUtility>stunned for 2s</style>, and a <style=cIsDamage>300%</style> shockwave to everything within 4m. <style=cIsUtility>In the air</style>: slam it into the floor for <style=cIsDamage>2000%</style>, and everyone within 10m is bashed down with it for <style=cIsDamage>1000%</style> and stunned. In the air, chains run <style=cIsUtility>from the slammed enemy</style> to everyone else in the air it drags down, <style=cIsDamage>330%</style> more each, breaking as they land.

rows.name: Rising Ram
rows.description: Lower your horns and charge 15m. Ram an enemy and it takes <style=cIsDamage>1200%</style>; chains snap onto every enemy standing on the ground within 10m for <style=cIsDamage>396%</style> each and haul them, you included, <style=cIsUtility>into a 2s float</style> (stunned, drifting slowly down); the chains break at the top. Ground only. The cooldown is <style=cIsUtility>halved</style> when the ram connects.

rows.name: Chain Gang
rows.description: Chains shoot from you to every enemy you can see within 20m (up to 20), haul them 6m into the air and slam them into the floor for <style=cIsDamage>6000%</style> each; anyone left is <style=cIsUtility>stunned for 3s</style>. Bosses are slammed where they stand.

rows.name: The Rake
rows.description: Fire The Rake, Wraith's tommy gun, for <style=cIsDamage>60% damage</style> per bullet, about 10 a second. It kicks hard. 52-round magazine.

rows.name: Card Trick
rows.description: Throw a magic card that <style=cIsUtility>homes in</style> on the enemy under your crosshair for <style=cIsDamage>400% damage</style>. Each card draws one of four tricks: <style=cIsHealth>Bleed</style> (5 stacks), a certain <style=cIsDamage>Critical</style> hit, a 2s <style=cIsUtility>Stun</style> or <style=cIsDamage>Burn</style> (5 stacks).

rows.name: Project Mind
rows.description: Mark a spot up to <style=cIsUtility>60m</style> away with purple smoke; press <style=cIsUtility>any key</style> to <style=cIsUtility>teleport</style> there at once.

rows.name: Full Auto
rows.description: Reload in a swirl of purple smoke: the magazine is <style=cIsUtility>full</style> and The Rake fires <style=cIsDamage>50% faster</style> (and kicks harder) until that magazine is empty.

rows.name: Telekinesis
rows.description: Lift <style=cIsUtility>every enemy within 30m</style> into the air, then <style=cIsUtility>throw them 50m</style> where you aim: each takes <style=cIsDamage>6000% damage</style> where it lands, <style=cIsDamage>50% more</style> if it hits a wall. Throw them off a cliff. Bosses are lifted a little, take the hit and are <style=cIsUtility>stunned</style> for 3s.
